text: As I move through these contemporary hallways, I am struck by the clarity and modernity of my surroundings. Glass walls and vibrant displays signal a dedication to innovation. Here, with the words R+D beckoning me, I feel a surge of curiosity and quiet awe—surrounded by the artifacts and ideas of research and development, I reflect on humanity's restless drive to advance and adapt. The environment feels charged with purpose and the optimism of possibility.
